npc.a_bearded_woman.actor: Stage acting was a waste of my immense talent. Not only am I a born leader, my talent is more profitable when it is used for conning people.
npc.a_bearded_woman.captain_1: I'd have been a much better captain then Kid was. I played several captains on stage and I was good! ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.captain_2: Where Kid longed for the appreciation of his men, I would rule by fear and with an iron fist!
npc.a_bearded_woman.cell: If you find some way to release me I might even let you live as reward! So you'd better do your best or I'll kill you!
npc.a_bearded_woman.greet: GET ME OUT OF HERE! NOW!
npc.a_bearded_woman.job: I am a great and famous actor! Not a princess, at all. I was only PRETENDING to be a princess. But try explaining that to those stupid pirates.
npc.a_bearded_woman.key_1: The key was lost in the underground river and has probably washed into the seven seas by now! ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.key_2: If that stupid Kid hadn't been so obsessed with kidnapping he'd not have sold his ship to buy the most expensive and complicated locks for his cells!
npc.a_bearded_woman.kid: He was always a fool with a heart too soft to become a feared pirate.
npc.a_bearded_woman.kidnap_1: Ah kidnapping is so much fun. That is, if you're not on the receiving end. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.kidnap_2: It's easy money and you have a chance to frighten and torture someone who can't fight back!
npc.a_bearded_woman.name: How dare you? I left to rot in this dirty cell and you have nothing better to do than chit chat?
npc.a_bearded_woman.pirate_1: In a just world, I would be captain of a grand ship, ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.pirate_2: Those pirates out there would now be my minions, and we would brave the seas and become the terror of the coastal towns! ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.pirate_3: If only our plan had worked!
npc.a_bearded_woman.plan_1: It was all captain Kid's idea. You see, he hated his name and planned to become known by the name captain Kidnap. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.plan_10: Things went bad when they decided to have a victory party. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.plan_11: As far as I could make out from the mumblings of the pirates, Kid lost the key to my cell while relieving himself in the underground river. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.plan_12: The fool decided to dive after it .. never to be seen again. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.plan_13: When I found out about Kid's demise I tried to convince the pirates it was a hoax, but they just won't believe me!
npc.a_bearded_woman.plan_2: All he needed was someone famous to kidnap. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.plan_3: Given his men's dismal lack of talent and intelligence that would have been quite a feat. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.plan_4: We knew each other from a few scams we did together in the past, so he contacted me. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.plan_5: I was to impersonate the famous Princess Lumelia. You know, the one everyone was looking for. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.plan_6: That would show his men and the other pirates what a great kidnapper he was. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.plan_7: He promised me that I would become his second in command and lead a wonderful life of plundering, robbing and pillaging. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.plan_8: So I agreed to impersonate the Princess for a while and it worked fine at first. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.plan_9: He returned with me dressed as the Princess from a raid on his own and was instantaneously the hero of the day for his men. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.plundering_1: As long as we stick to undefended coastal towns we can make an easy fortune. Har Har! ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.plundering_2: As soon as I get out of here I'll finally become a pirate captain on my own. I don't need Captain Kid!
npc.a_bearded_woman.princess: Me playing a princess was just part of a cunning plan we had.
npc.a_bearded_woman.rot: YOU .. YOU .. You are as good as dead! I will get you! Do you hear me? I will have your head! On a platter!
npc.a_bearded_woman.scams_1: The more stupid the people are, the easier it is to con them. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.scams_2: And the poorer they are the less means they have to get revenge. Har Har! ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.scams_3: So I make sure I ruin those I scam. Then they have other things to worry about than getting revenge on me.
npc.a_bearded_woman.ship_1: Captain Kid sold his ship to buy pointless things like those insanely expensive locks for the cell doors. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.ship_2: He said the canoes would do for a while. ...
npc.a_bearded_woman.ship_3: I got the impression he was not overly sad to part with the ship because he was known to suffer a lot from seasickness.
npc.a_beautiful_girl.greet: So you have come, {0}. I hoped you would not...
npc.a_beggar.greet: Hi! What is it, what d'ye {want}?
npc.a_beggar.want: The guys from the magistrate sent you here, didn't they?
npc.a_beggar.yes_audience: Thought so. You'll have to talk to the king though. The beggar king that is. The king does not grant an audience to just everyone. You know how those kings are, don't you?
npc.a_beggar.yes_dedication: So why don't you show your dedication to the poor? Go and help Chavis at the poor house. He's collecting food for people like us.
npc.a_beggar.yes_help: However, to get an audience with the king, you'll have to help his subjects a bit.
npc.a_beggar.yes_palace: If you brought enough of the stuff you'll see that the king will grant you entrance in his {palace}.
npc.a_beggar.yes_subjects: His subjects that would be us, the poor, you know?
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.farewell: Good bye and don't forget me!
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.form287_denied: Oh, what a pity. Go see one of my colleagues. I give you the permission to get Form 287. Bye!
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.form287_grant: Sure, you can get it from me. Here you are. Bye.
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.form145_intro: Tell me if you liked it when you come back. What is your name?
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.form356_done: INCREDIBLE, you did it!! Have fun at Pumin's Domain!
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.form356_intro: How very interesting. I need to tell that to my master immediately. Please go to my colleagues and ask for Form 356. You will need it in order to proceed.
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.form356_need_145: Sorry, you need Form 145 to get Form 356. Come back when you have it.
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.form356_granted: You are better than I thought! Congratulations, here you are: Form 356!
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.form411_granted: Great. Here you are. Form 411. Come back anytime you want to talk. Bye.
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.greet: Hello {0}, welcome to the atrium of Pumin's Domain. We require some information from you before we can let you pass. Where do you want to go?
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.pumin_intro_cautio: I'm not sure if you know what you are doing but anyway. Your name is?
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.need_form287: Form 411? You need Form 287 to get that! Do you have it?
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.pumin_intro: Sure, where else. Everyone likes to meet my master, he is a great demon, isn't he? Your name is ...?
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.walkaway: Good bye and don't forget me!
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.same_vocation: I was a {0}, too, before I died!! What do you want from me?
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.form145_require_41: That's right, you can get Form 145 from me. However, I need Form 411 first. Come back when you have it.
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.form145_granted: Well done! You have Form 411! Here is Form 145. Have fun with it.
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.spell_vocation: {0}, is that right?! What do you want from me?
npc.a_dead_bureaucrat.warn_weapon: Huhu, please don't hurt me with your {0}! Reason of your visit?
npc.a_behemoth.greet: Pssst! Keep it down! <gives you an elaborate report on monster activity>
npc.a_dragon_lord.greet: Greetings, mortal. What brings you to my domain?
npc.a_dragon_mother.assistance_1: Wretched creatures of ice have stolen my egg that was close to hatching.
npc.a_dragon_mother.assistance_2: Since I'm too huge to enter those lower Tunnels I have to ask you to take care of my {egg}. Will you do this?
npc.a_dragon_mother.egg_1: As I told you, fiendish ice creatures dragged my egg into the lower caves.
npc.a_dragon_mother.egg_2: Without enough heat the egg will die soon. Venture there and save my hatchling and the knowledge you seek shall be yours!
npc.a_dragon_mother.greet_done: You have done me a favour and the knowledge you are seeking shall be yours. I melted the ice for you, you can pass now.
npc.a_dragon_mother.greet_need_help: Greetings humans! Consider yourselfs lucky, I'm in need of {help}.
npc.a_dragon_mother.help: I'm aware what you are looking for. Usually I would rather devour you, but due to unfortunate circumstances, I need your {assistance}.
npc.a_dragon_mother.yes_1: So return to the upper tunnels where cultists and ice golems dwell. Somewhere in these tunnels you will find a small prison haunted by a ghost. South of this prison cell there is a tunnel that will lead you eastwards.
npc.a_dragon_mother.yes_2: Follow the tunnel until you reach a small cave. Step down and down until you see a blue energy field. It will lead you to my egg. It is sealed so that not everyone may enter the room. But you have the permission now.
npc.a_fluffy_squirrel.acorn: Chh? Chhh?? <though you don't understand squirrelish, that one seems really excited>
npc.a_fluffy_squirrel.trade_offer: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>
npc.a_swan.mission_intro.1: My sister Ikassis sent you? Blessed be her soul! Yes, it is true: I need help. Listen, I will tell you a secret but please don't break it. As you might already suspect I'm not really a swan but a fae. ...
npc.a_swan.mission_intro.2: But other than many of my siblings I did not take over a swan's body. I'm a swan maiden and this is one of my two aspects. I can take the shape of a swan as well as that of a young maiden. ...
npc.a_swan.mission_intro.3: But to do so I need a magical artefact: a cloak made of swan feathers. If I lose this cloak - or someone steals it from me - I'm stuck to the form of a swan and can't change shape anymore. And this is exactly what happened: ...
npc.a_swan.mission_intro.4: A troll stalked me while I was bathing in the river and he stole my cloak. Now I am trapped in the form of a swan. Please, can you find the thief and bring back the cloak?
npc.a_swan.mission_recover.1: This is everything that remained of my cloak? That's terrible! However, I guess I can put the feathers together again. Yes, that should be enough feathers. ...
npc.a_swan.mission_recover.2: Please give them to me so I can restore my cloak. But don't watch me! Swan maidens don't like to be observed. Nature's blessings, human being. I will tell Ikassis that you have been of great assistance.
npc.a_swan.mission_accept.1: Thank you, human being! I guess the thieving troll headed to the mountains east of here. As far as I know you can only reach these mountain tops by diving into a small cave. ...
npc.a_swan.mission_accept.2: The connecting tunnels will lead you to a mountain where you may discover him. I heard a man named Jerom talking about this when he passed by this river. Perhaps he knows more about it.
npc.a_swan.need_feathers: You need to deliver me like 5 feathers.
npc.a_swan.not_on_mission: You are not on that mission.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.ab_dendriel: Me parents live here before town was. Me not care about lil' ones.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.cenath: Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their business.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.cyclops: Me people not live here much. Most are far away.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.dragon_shield: Do lil' one want to trade a dragon shield?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.elves: Me not fight them, they not fight me.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.excalibug: Me wish I could make weapon like it.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.fire_sword: Do lil' one want to trade a fire sword?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.god: You shut up. Me not want to hear.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.lil_lil: Lil' lil' ones are so fun. We often chat.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.mesh_kaha_rogh: Steel that is singing when forged. No one knows where find today.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.minotaurs: They were friend with me parents. Long before elves here, they often made visit. No longer come here.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.name: I called Bencthyclthrtrprr by me people. Lil' ones me call Big Ben.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.quest_bast_check: Lil' one bring three bast skirts?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.quest_bast_complete: Good good! Woman happy will be. Now me happy too and help you.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.quest_bast_reminder: Lil' one bring three bast skirts.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.quest_bast_request: Me need gift for woman. We dance, so me want to give her bast skirt. But she big is. So I need many to make big one. Bring three okay? Me wait.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.quest_bast_wait: Wait. Me work no cheap is. Do favour for me first, yes?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.quest_soul_orb_offe: Uh. Me can make some nasty lil' bolt from soul orbs. Lil' one want to trade all?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.quest_uth_kean_offe: Very noble. Shiny. Me like. But breaks so fast. Me can make from shiny armour. Lil' one want to trade?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.quest_uth_lokr_offe: Firy steel it is. Need green ones' breath to melt. Or red even better. Me can make from shield. Lil' one want to trade?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.quest_uth_prta_offe: Good iron is. Me friends use it much for fight. Me can make from weapon. Lil' one want to trade?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.quest_za_ralator_of: Hellsteel is. Cursed and evil. Dangerous to work with. Me can make from evil helmet. Lil' one want to trade?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.response_cling_clan: Cling clang! Me done good work today! Li'l one gets double bolts!
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.steel: Manny kinds of. Like {Mesh Kaha Rogh'}, {Za'Kalortith}, {Uth'Byth}, {Uth'Morc}, {Uth'Amon}, {Uth'Maer}, {Uth'Doon}, and {Zatragil}.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.sword_valor: Do lil' one want to trade a sword of valor?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.teshial: Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their business.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.tibia: One day I'll go and look.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.uth_amon: Heartiron from heart of big old mountain, found very deep. Lil' lil ones fiercely defend. Not wanting to have it used for stuff but holy stuff.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.uth_byth: Not good to make stuff off. Bad steel it is. But eating magic, so useful is.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.uth_doon: It's high steel called. Only lil' lil' ones know how make.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.uth_maer: Brightsteel is. Much art made with it. Sorcerers too lazy and afraid to enchant much.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.warlord_sword: Do lil' one want to trade a warlord sword?
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.za_kalortith: It's evil. Demon iron is. No good cyclops goes where you can find and need evil flame to melt.
npc.a_sweaty_cyclops.zatragil: Most ancients use dream silver for different stuff. Now ancients most gone. Most not know about.
npc.nah_bob.cookie_ask: You brought cookies! How nice of you! Can I have one?
npc.nah_bob.cookie_none: You have no cookie that I'd like.
npc.nah_bob.cookie_rage: You see, good deeds like this will ... YOU ... YOU SPAWN OF EVIL! I WILL MAKE SURE THE MASTER LEARNS ABOUT THIS!
npc.nah_bob.farewell: Bye now, Neutrala {0}. Visit old Bob again one day!
npc.nah_bob.greet: <Sighs> Another {customer}! I've only just sat down! What is it, {0}?
npc.nah_bob.laugh_2: {0}, that almost sounded like the word of greeting. Humans - cute they are!
npc.nah_bob.no_place: Whoa! A human! This is no place for you, {0}. Go and play somewhere else.
npc.nah_bob.sendtrade: At your service, just browse through my wares.
npc.nah_bob.trade_denied: I'm sorry, human. But you need Gabel's permission to trade with me.
npc.nilsor.blossom_info: The purple kiss is a plant that grows in a place called jungle. You will have to use a kitchen knife to harvest its blossom. Do you have a blossom of a purple kiss with you?
npc.nilsor.cactus_info: You will find this kind of cactus at places that are called deserts. Only an ordinary kitchen knife will be precise enough to produce the ingredient weneed. Do you have a part of that cactus with you?
npc.nilsor.comeback: Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.greet: Greetings, traveller {0}. Is there anything I can {do for you}?
npc.nilsor.herb_info: The frostbite herb is a local plant but its quite rare. You can find it on mountain peaks. You will need to cut it with a fine kitchen knife. Do you have a frostbite herb with you?
npc.nilsor.hydra_tongue_info: The hydra tongue is a common pest plant in warmer regions. You might find one in a shop. Do you have a hydra tongue with you?
npc.nilsor.mission_accept_1: A thousand thanks in advance. I need no less than 7 ingredients for the cure. You can ask me about each specifically ...
npc.nilsor.mission_accept_2: I need a part of the sun adorer cactus, a vial of geyser water, sulphur of a lava hole, a frostbite herb, a blossom of a purple kiss, a hydra tongue and spores of a giant glimmercap mushroom ...
npc.nilsor.mission_accept_3: Turn them in individually by talking about them to me. As soon as I obtained them all, talk to me about the medicine. First time bring a Part of the Sun Adorer {Cactus}.
npc.nilsor.mission_complete_1: Thank you. Now I have all necessary ingredients. As a reward I grant you the use of our dog sled, which is located to the east of here. ...
npc.nilsor.mission_complete_2: The dogs can be a bit moody, but if you always carry some ham with you there shouldnt be any problems. Oh, and Hjaern might have a mission for you. So maybe you go and talk to him.
npc.nilsor.mission_intro_1: I am in dire need of help. A plague has befallen my dogs. I even called a druid of Carlin for help but all he could do was to recommend some strong medicine ...
npc.nilsor.mission_intro_2: The thing is the ingredients of the medicine are extremely rare and some only exist in far away and distant lands. If you could help me collecting the ingredients, I would be eternally grateful ...
npc.nilsor.mission_intro_3: Are you willing to help me?
npc.nilsor.mission_progress: What for ingredient do you have?
npc.nilsor.no_ingredient: Then come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.no_mission: I have now no mission for you.
npc.nilsor.spores_info: The giant glimmercap mushroom exists in caves and other preferably warm and humid places. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on a mushroom to collectits spores. Do you have the glimmercap spores?
npc.nilsor.sulphur_info: I need fine sulphur of an inactive lava hole. No other sulphur will do. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on an inactive lava hole. Do you have fine sulphur with you?
npc.nilsor.thanks_blossom: Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me the {Hydra Tongue}
npc.nilsor.thanks_cactus: Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me Geyser {Water} in a Waterskin.
npc.nilsor.thanks_herb: Thank you for this ingredient Now bring me Purple Kiss {Blossom}.
npc.nilsor.thanks_hydra: Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me {Spores} of a Giant Glimmercap Mushroom.
npc.nilsor.thanks_spores: Thank you for this ingredient. Now you finish your {mission}
npc.nilsor.thanks_sulphur: Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me the Frostbite {Herb}
npc.nilsor.thanks_water: Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me Fine {Sulphur}.
npc.nilsor.travel_ask: Do you want to travel to Svargrond?
npc.nilsor.water_info_1: You will need a specially prepared waterskin to collect the water. You can buy one from me ...
npc.nilsor.water_info_2: Use it on a geyser that is NOT active. The water of active geysers is far too hot. You can find inactive geysers on Okolnir. Do you have some geyser water with you?
npc.nilsor.waterskin_ask: Do you want to buy a waterskin for 25 gold?
npc.nina.greet: Beware, if you go any further you will have to fight a large group of Chosen. This place is called the Fire Dragon Dojo. Tread carefully since these are lizard training grounds.
npc.nina.chosen: The lizards here are the chosen ones of their kind. We believe them to be the strongest warriors in these lands.So I lead my people here to learn their ways. We are mere assassins but they are using foreign techniques and seem to be far more efficient
npc.nina.fire_dragon_dojo: We of the Grey Shadow clan are studying the ways of the Chosen. Our training is hard, encounters with the lizards often deadly. Every one of us fights on his own. Each one more deadly than the other. Under my lead we wil rise renewed, as the Shadow Nina.
npc.nina.name: I am Nina, leader of the Grey Shadow clan. Me and my followers, the Shadow Nina, are exploring the largely uncharted parts of the continent Zao.
npc.ninos.greet: Hello. How may I help you {0}? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.
npc.ninos.farewell: It was a pleasure to help you, {0}.
npc.ninos.measurements: Oh they don't change that much since in the old days as... <tells a boring and confusing story about a cake, a parcel, himself and two squirrels, at least he tells you his measurements in the end>
npc.nokmir.mission_intro: I don't see how you could help me. I'm in deep, deep trouble. I'm accused of having stolen a {ring} from Rerun, but I haven't.
npc.nokmir.ring_story_1: He said he still had it after work. On that evening, {Grombur}, {Rerun} and me opened a cask of beer in one of the mine tunnels. We had a fun evening there. ...
npc.nokmir.ring_story_2: On the next day, the guards brought me to emperor {Rehal}, and Rerun was there, too. He said I had stolen his ring. I'd never steal, you have to believe me.
npc.nokmir.grombur_info: Maybe Grombur knows more than me. The thing is he won't talk to me, and he will surely not accuse his best friend as a liar. What a dilemma!
npc.nokmir.rerun_info: He's a miner in the southern wing. Maybe he has lost the ring there... but even if I find the ring, no one will believe me. Someone should talk to Grombur. He's Rerun's best friend.
npc.nokmir.rehal_info: He's a good emperor but I doubt he is wise enough to see the truth behind that false accusation against me. If just someone would find out the truth about that whole mess.
npc.nokmir.mission_complete: WHAT?! I can't believe it. You saved my life... well, at least one week of it 'cause that would have been the time I had to spend in jail. If you want to, you can pass the door now and take a look at the northern mines. Have fun!
npc.norma.addon_ask: Oh, you're back already? Did you bring a legion helmet, 100 chicken feathers and 50 honeycombs?
npc.norma.addon_instructions: Okay, here we go, listen closely! I need a few things... a basic hat of course, maybe a legion helmet would do. Then about 100 chicken feathers... and 50 honeycombs as glue. That's it, come back to me once you gathered it!!
npc.norma.addon_no: Aw, I guess you don't like feather hats. No big deal.
npc.norma.addon_no_feathers: Sorry, but you don't have enough chicken feathers.
npc.norma.addon_no_helmet: Sorry, but I can't see a legion helmet.
npc.norma.addon_no_honeycombs: Sorry, but you don't have enough honeycombs.
npc.norma.addon_offer: Pretty, isn't it? I made it myself, but I could teach you how to do that if you like. What do you say?
npc.norma.addon_success: Great job! That must have taken a lot of work. Okay, you put it like this... then glue like this... here!
npc.norma.farewell: Bye, {0}! Visit my bar more often!
npc.norma.greet: Hello there, {0}! Looking for some fun? Step into my bar and have a {drink}!
npc.olrik.dice_lose: Ok, here we go ... {0}! You lose! Try again.
npc.olrik.dice_win: Ok, here we go ... {0}! You have won! How lucky you are! So listen ...<tells you what you need to know>
npc.olrik.measurements_gamble: My measurements? Listen, lets make that a bit more exciting ... No, no, not what you think! I mean let's gamble. I will roll a dice. If I roll a 6 you win and I'll tell you what you need to know, else I win and get 5 gold. Deal?
npc.narsai.mission_ask: Could you help me do a ritual?
npc.narsai.ingredient_list: Here is the list of ingredients that are missing to complete the ritual.
npc.narsai.materials_ask: Did you bring all the materials I informed you about?
npc.narsai.ritual_complete: Thank you this stage of the ritual is complete.
npc.nelly.voice_selling: Also selling runes, potions and magical equipment!
npc.nelly.greet: Hello {0}, What can I do for you? I'm working for the post office, but I also trade with important {potions}, {runes} and other magical equipment.
npc.nielson.voice_passages: Passages to Senja, Folda and Vega.
npc.nielson.greet: Ahoi, young man {0} and welcome to the Nordic Tibia Ferries. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
npc.nielson.passage_info: Where do you want to go today? We serve the routes to {Folda}, {Senja} and {Vega} and back to Tibia.
npc.nielson.job: We are ferrymen. We transport goods and passengers to the Ice Islands.
npc.ninev.greet: Welcome, young {0}! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free or you want the {adventurer stone}?
npc.ninev.walkaway: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.
npc.ninev.stake_intro_1: A blessed stake to defeat evil spirits? I do know an old prayer which is said to grant sacred power and to be able to bind this power to someone, or something. ...
npc.ninev.stake_intro_2: However, this prayer needs the combined energy of ten priests. Each of them has to say one line of the prayer. ...
npc.ninev.stake_intro_3: I could start with the prayer, but since the next priest has to be in a different location, you probably will have to travel a lot. ...
npc.ninev.stake_intro_4: Is this stake really important enough to you so that you are willing to take this burden?
npc.ninev.stake_get_gamon: Alright, I guess you need a stake first. Maybe Gamon can help you, the leg of a chair or something could just do. Try asking him for a stake, and if you have one, bring it back to me.
npc.ninev.stake_no_item: I guess you couldn't convince Gamon to give you a stake, eh?
npc.ninev.stake_prayer_ask: Yes, I was informed what to do. Are you prepared to receive my line of the prayer?
npc.ninev.stake_prayer_1: So receive my prayer: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.ninev.stake_visit_tibra: You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church now.
npc.ninev.stake_already_done: You already received my line of the prayer.
npc.ninev.twist_intro_1: This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
npc.ninev.twist_intro_2: It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...
npc.ninev.twist_intro_3: The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
npc.ninev.twist_intro_4: Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?
npc.ninev.twist_received: So receive the protection of the twist of fate, pilgrim.
npc.ninev.twist_declined: Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.ninev.stone_free_ask: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for free?
npc.ninev.stone_paid_ask: Ah, you want to replace your adventurer's stone for 30 gold?
npc.ninev.stone_no_money: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
npc.ninev.heal_fire: You are burning. Let me quench those flames.
npc.ninev.heal_poison: You are poisoned. Let me soothe your pain.
npc.ninev.heal_energy: You are electrified, my child. Let me help you to stop trembling.
npc.ninev.heal_wounds: You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.ninev.heal_not_needed: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.ninev.pilgrimage_info: Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.ninev.blessings_info: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.ninev.bless_spiritual_has: I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.ninev.bless_spiritual_no: You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.ninev.bless_embrace_has: I can sense that the druids north of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.ninev.bless_embrace_no: The druids north of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.ninev.bless_suns_has: I can see you received the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.ninev.bless_suns_no: You can ask for the blessing of the two suns in the suntower near Ab'Dendriel.
npc.ninev.bless_phoenix_has: I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.ninev.bless_phoenix_no: The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.ninev.bless_solitude_has: I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.ninev.bless_solitude_no: Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.

npc.obi.greet: Hello, hello, {0}! Please come in, look, and buy! If you like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}!
npc.obi.farewell: Farewell, I hope you were satisfied with our service.
npc.obi.trade: Of course, just browse through my wares.
npc.ocelus.eleonore_response: I heard the birds sing about her beauty. But how could a human rival the enchanting beauty of a {mermaid}?
npc.ocelus.mermaid_1: Oh yes, I noticed that lovely mermaid. From afar of course. I would not dare to step into the eyes of such a lovely creature. ...
npc.ocelus.mermaid_2: ... I guess I am quite shy. Oh my, if I were not blue, I would turn red now. If there would be someone to arrange a {date} with her.
npc.ocelus.mermaid_poem: Oh my. Its not easy to impress a mermaid I guess. Please get me a {love poem}. I think elves are the greatest poets so their city seems like a good place to look for one.
npc.ocelus.date_ask: Will you ask the mermaid Marina if she would date me?
npc.ocelus.date_thanks: Thank you. How ironic, a human granting a djinn a wish.
npc.ocelus.poem_enchant: Excellent. Here, with this little spell I enable you to recite the poem like a true elven poet. Now go and ask her for a date again.
npc.ocelus.poem_ask: Did you get a love poem from Ab'Dendriel?
npc.oldrak.greet: Welcome {0}! Only rarely I can welcome {visitors} these days.
npc.oldrak.walkaway: Take care, it's dangerous out there.
npc.oldrak.mission_ask: How do you know? Did you go into the infested area?
npc.oldrak.mission_wait: You better don't return here until you've defeated the Demon Oak.
npc.oldrak.mission_done_1: You chopped down the demon oak?!? Unbelievable!! Let's hope it doesn't come back. As long as evil is still existent in the soil of the plains, it won't be over. Still, the demons suffered a setback, that's for sure. ...
npc.oldrak.mission_done_2: For your brave action, I tell you a secret which has been kept for many many years. There is an old house south of the location where you found the demon oak. There should be a grave with the name 'Yesim Adeit' somewhere close by. ...
npc.oldrak.mission_done_3: It belongs to a Daramian nobleman named 'Teme Saiyid'. I knew him well and he told me -almost augured- that someone will come who is worthy to obtain his treasure. I'm sure this 'someone' is you. Good luck in finding it!
npc.oldrak.mission_yes: A demon oak?!? <mumbles some blessings> May the gods be on our side. You'll need a {hallowed axe} to harm that tree. Bring me a simple {axe} and I'll prepare it for you.
npc.oldrak.mission_lie: I don't believe a word of it! How rude to lie to a monk!
npc.oldrak.axe_ask: Ahh, you've got an axe. Very good. I can make a hallowed axe out of it. It will cost you... er... a donation of 1,000 gold. Alright?
npc.oldrak.axe_first: You have to first talk about {demon oak} or the {mission} before we continue.
npc.oldrak.axe_done: Let's see....<mumbles a prayer>....here we go. The blessing on this axe will be absorbed by all the demonic energy around here. I presume it will not last very long, so better hurry. Actually, I can refresh the blessing as often as you like.
npc.oldrak.axe_missing: There is no axe with you.
npc.oldrak.money_missing: There is not enough of money with you.
npc.oldrak.mission_no: What a pity! Let me know when you managed to get in there. Maybe I can help you when we know what we are dealing with.
npc.oldrak.hugo: Ah, the curse of the Plains of Havoc, the hidden beast, the unbeatable foe. I've been living here for years and I'm sure this is only a myth.
npc.oldrak.myth: There are many tales about the fearsome Hugo. It's said it's an abnormality, accidentally created by Yenny the Gentle. It's half demon, half something else and people say it's still alive after all these years.
npc.oldrak.yenny: Yenny, known as the Gentle, was one of the most powerful wielders of magic in ancient times. She was known throughout the world for her mercy and kindness.
npc.oldrak.tible_ask: Would you like to buy a The Holy Tible for 1000 gold?
npc.oldrak.tible_quest_first: You need to complete the quest for the book first before you can buy The Holy Tible.
npc.oldrak.tible_done: Here is your The Holy Tible.
npc.oldrak.not_enough_money: You do not have enough money.
npc.one_eyed_joe.greet_done: Well done! But know this: The cursed crystal seems to regenerate over time. It could be necessary to come back and repeat whatever you have done down there.
npc.one_eyed_joe.greet: Hello there. I'm sorry, I hardly noticed you. I'm a bit nervous. The spooky {sounds} down there, you know
npc.one_eyed_joe.mission_intro_1: As for myself I haven't been down there. But I heard some disturbing rumours. In these caves are wonderful crystal formations. Some more poetically inclined fellows call them the crystal gardens. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.mission_intro_2: At first glance it seems to be a beautiful - and precious - surrounding. But in truth, deep down in these caverns exists an old evil. Want to hear more?
npc.one_eyed_joe.not_done: Hmm. No, I don't think so. I still feel this strange prickling in my toes.
npc.one_eyed_joe.protect_ears: Protect your ears? Hmm ... Wasn't there some fabulous seafarer who used wax or something to plug his ears? There was a story about horrible bird-women or something ...? No, sounds like hogwash, doesn't it.
npc.one_eyed_joe.evil_crystal_1: The evil I mentioned is a strange crystal, imbued with some kind of unholy energy. It is very hard to destroy, no weapon is able to shatter the thing. Maybe a jarring, very loud sound could destroy it. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.evil_crystal_2: I heard of creatures, that are able to utter ear-splitting sounds. Don't remember the name, though. Would you go down there and try to destroy the crystal?
npc.one_eyed_joe.good_luck: Great! Good luck and be careful down there!
npc.one_eyed_joe.crystals_1: In my humble opinion a pirate should win a fortune by boarding ships not by crawling through caves and tunnels. But who am I to bring into question the captain's decision. All I know is that they sell the crystals at a high price. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.crystals_2: A certain amount of the crystals is ground to crystal dust with a special kind of mill. Don't ask me why. Some kind of magical component perhaps that they sell to mages and sorcerers.
npc.one_eyed_joe.sounds_1: These caves are incredibly beautiful, {crystals} in vibrant colours grow there like exotic flowers. There are more than a few captains who send down their men in order to quarry the precious crystals. ...
npc.one_eyed_joe.sounds_2: But there are few volunteers. Often the crystal gatherers disappear and are never seen again. Other poor fellows then meet their former shipmates in the form of ghosts or skeletons. It's a {cursed} area, something evil is down there!
npc.one_eyed_joe.job: I'm a pirate. Normally I'm sailing the seas, boarding other ships and gathering treasures. But at the moment my captain graciously assigned me to watch this {cursed} entrance.
npc.one_eyed_joe.name: I'm One-Eyed Joe. From Josephina, got that? And I regard this eye patch as a personal feature of beauty!
npc.one_eyed_joe.bye: Good bye adventurer. It was nice to talk with you.
npc.one_eyed_joe.progress: Ah, the brave adventurer who sought to destroy the evil crystal down there. Have you been successful?
npc.oswald.walkaway: Good bye, and don't come back too soon.
npc.oswald.invitation_ask: What? So why in the world should I give you an invitation? It's not as if you were someone important, are you?
npc.oswald.invitation_donate: Well, rich and generous people are always welcome in the palace.If you donate 1000 gold to a fund I oversee, I'll give you an invitation, ok?
npc.oswald.gold_doubt: Not that I am bribeable but I doubt that you own 1000 gold pieces. Or do you?
npc.ottokar.medicine_ask: Did you bring me the medicine pouch?
npc.ottokar.medicine_needed: I need a {medicine pouch}, to give you the {belongings of deceased}. Come back when you have them.
npc.ottokar.no_items: You do not have the required items.
npc.oblivion.greet: A shadow preceded you. You wish?
npc.oblivion.scroll_intro: Lost. Hidden. The keys are shadow names. Find them, they will talk to me and reveal what is hidden. Will you go on that quest?
npc.oblivion.mission_start_1: Then into the vampire crypts, deep down, you must go. ...
npc.oblivion.mission_start_2: There... three graves where the shadows swirl, unseen. The first one: name the colour of the silent gong. Then ...
npc.oblivion.mission_start_3: The second: the name that is silent now in the halls of Darkstone ...
npc.oblivion.mission_start_4: The third: the lost beauty of Dunesea. It must be remembered, the shadows command it. Go now.
npc.oblivion.found_ask: Yes. Have you gone there and found what you sought?
npc.oblivion.begin_colour: Tell me. Begin with the colour.
npc.oblivion.bronze_correct: Yes. The shadows say this is true. The beauty of House Dunesea, name it.
npc.oblivion.floating_correct: The floating gardens. Too beautiful to lie asleep in the memory of men. Yes. The name that is no more in Darkstone?
npc.oblivion.mission_complete_1: Ah, the Lady of Darkstone. You have done well to remember her name. ...
npc.oblivion.mission_complete_2: Now, the shadows say the thing you seek lies next to Akab, the Quarrelsome. ...
npc.oblivion.mission_complete_3: No coal is burned in his honour. Find his resting place and dig near it. Now go.

npc.ahmet.i_see_you_3: I see: You want me to add an additional story to this book. A legend about how it brings ill luck to kill a white deer. I could do that, yes. It costs 5000 gold, however. Are you still interested?
npc.ahmet.and_here_they_4: And here they are! Now forget where you got them from.

npc.ambassador_of_rathleton.i_dont_need_: I don't need a present right now. Thank you.
npc.amber.ah_you_noticed_1: Ah, you noticed my new accessory? Sorry, this one is not for sale. It's handmade from rare minotaur leather.
npc.amber.ah_right_almost_2: Ah, right, almost forgot about the backpack! Have you brought me 100 pieces of minotaur leather as requested?
npc.amber.just_in_time_3: Just in time! Your backpack is finished. Here you go, I hope you like it.
npc.amber.uh_i_didnt_4: Uh... I didn't expect you to return that early. Sorry, but I'm not finished yet with your backpack. I'm doing the best I can, promised.
npc.amber.sorry_but_i_5: Sorry, but I can only make one backpack per person, else I'd have to close my shop and open a leather manufactory.
npc.amber.well_if_you_6: Well, if you really like this backpack, I could make one for you, but minotaur leather is hard to come by these days. Are you willing to put some work into this?
npc.amber.alright_then_if_7: Alright then, if you bring me 100 pieces of fine minotaur leather I will see what I can do for you. You probably have to kill really many minotaurs though... so good luck!
npc.amber.sorry_but_i_8: Sorry, but I don't run a welfare office, you know... no pain, no gain.
npc.amber.sorry_but_thats_9: Sorry, but that's not enough leather yet to make one of these backpacks. Would you rather like to buy a normal backpack for 10 gold?

npc.amber.i_know_its_11: I know, it's quite some work... don't lose heart, just keep killing minotaurs and you'll eventually get lucky. Would you rather like to buy a normal backpack for 10 gold?

npc.andrew_lyze.this_sarcophagus_seals_2: This sarcophagus seals the entrance to the caves down there. Only here you can get all the {materials} you need for a working compass of this kind. So no entrance here - no further magic compasses in Tibia. In theory.

npc.angelo.do_you_have_3: Do you have the sample I asked you for?

npc.angelo.mota_is_short_10: MoTA is short for the recently founded Museum of Tibian Arts. We work together in close collaboration. New {results} are communicated to the museum instantly.
npc.angelo.we_have_no_11: We have no scientific results so far to reach our {goal}, because my workers aren't back yet. Should I be {worried}?

npc.angelo.fantastic_go_there_13: Fantastic! Go there and then tell me what you've seen. I've opened the door for you. Take care of yourself!

npc.angelo.we_dont_know_15: We don't know yet to wich extent the cave and the dark pyramid belong together. Thisi s what we try to find out. Maybe the history of this place has to be rewritten.

npc.angus.sigh_i_think_34: *Sigh* I think the time is right to grant you another chance to get that ice. Hurry up this time.

npc.angus.a_little_bit_36: A little bit battered but it will do. Thank you! If you think you are ready, ask for another butterfly hunt.

npc.angus.ah_finally_i_40: Ah, finally. I started to wonder what took you so long. But thank you! Another fine sample, indeed. Just tell me when you are ready to continue with the plant collection.
npc.angus.what_a_lovely_41: What a lovely sample! With that you have finished your plant collection missions.
npc.angus.yes_that_is_42: Yes, that is the prized relic we have been looking for so long. You did a great job, thank you.

npc.angus.you_really_got_44: You really got it? Amazing! Thank you for your efforts.
npc.angus.excellent_this_mission_45: Excellent. This mission is easy but nonetheless vital. Travel to Ab'Dendriel and get the book.
npc.angus.let_me_have_46: Let me have a look! Yes, that's what we wanted. A copy of 'Songs of the Forest'. I won't ask any questions about those bloodstains.
npc.angus.in_the_ruins_47: In the ruins of north-western Edron you should be able to find a memory stone. Good luck.
npc.angus.a_flawless_memory_48: A flawless memory stone! Incredible! It will take years even to figure out how it works but what an opportunity for science, thank you!
npc.angus.excellent_here_take_49: Excellent! Here, take this tracing paper and use it on the object you will find there to create a copy of the ancient runes.
npc.angus.its_a_bit_50: It's a bit wrinkled but it will do. Thanks again.

npc.angus.just_in_time_54: Just in time! With this spectral article we can start the final phase of our research.
npc.angus.good_just_take_55: Good, just take this spectral essence and use it on the strange carving in this building as well as on the corresponding tile in our base at Northport ...
npc.angus.poor_ratha_thank_56: Poor Ratha. Thank you for returning this skull to the society. We will see to a honourable burial of Ratha.
npc.angus.come_back_when_57: Come back when you find any information.
npc.angus.marvellous_you_brought_58: Marvellous! You brought a giant smith hammer for the explorer society!

npc.angus.its_always_a_61: It's always a sad day when we learn about the death of a member. But at least we learnt about his fate. Thank you, here is your reward.
